title: Toronto Edge Summit — expense capture & vendor roster
content:
Quick pocket notes for Edge Infra Summit (Toronto) — keep this messy. Use as receipts capture and contacts reference.

Event overview:
- Name: Edge Infrastructure Summit 2026 (Toronto)
- Dates: 2026-04-20 — 2026-04-23 (arrive 4/19 evening, depart 4/24 morning)
- Venue: Metro Toronto Convention Centre (South Building)
- Team attending: Maya (speaker), Jordan (attendee), Priya (partner ops backup)

Primary goals:
- Capture all billable travel expenses and vendor invoices within 7 days of return.
- Confirm speaker AV + laptop passthrough day before talk (4/20).
- Collect partner booth receipts and vendor contact cards.

Pre-trip checklist (short):
- [ ] Corporate card assigned: Redwood #ending 4321 — primary for meals and taxis. Save photo of card? no.
- [ ] Submit pre-approval for hotel nights in Concur (code: EXP-TR-22-EDGE).
- [ ] Book car service to/from YYZ (preferred: Maple City Limo). Save phone and invoice.
- [ ] Upload passport + proof of vaccination (if requested) to TravelOps folder.
- [ ] Print speaker slide PDF and USB copy; ask AV for HDMI adapter + dongles.

Hotel / lodging (booked):
- Hotel: Thompson Toronto — King St (confirmation: TTO-88421)
- Check-in: 2026-04-19, check-out: 2026-04-24
- Notes: Room charged to company on nights 4/19–4/23. Split receipt on check-out if partner owes portion.

Flights (booked):
- Outbound: AA 321 (SFO-YYZ) 4/19 08:10 — 16:05 (red-eye avoided)
- Return: AC 814 (YYZ-SFO) 4/24 18:30 — 20:55
- Baggage: 1 checked bag (keep receipts for overweight). Keep boarding passes saved to phone + screenshots.

Per-diem / expense rules (summary):
- Domestic (CAN) per-diem: follow Redwood policy for international city-tier 2. Convert CAD receipts to USD at card rate and note conversion on expense form.
- Meals: itemized receipts required for any single meal > $75 CAD.
- Taxis/rideshare: take photo of receipt and add geotag or note route (e.g., YYZ->hotel).
- Tipping: allowable within reason, record amounts on expense line.

Expense capture process (do this ASAP):
1) Immediately snap phone photo of every receipt (group in Photos album "Edge-YYZ-Receipts").
2) Use company Expense App to submit each day; tag with project code: INFRA-EDGE-2026.
3) Upload larger vendor invoices (booth builder, furniture) to Confluence attachment in event page and email procurement@redwood.ai with copy.
4) For cash reimbursements (rare): write name/date/purpose on paper receipt and scan.

Vendor / contacts roster (save in phone + Slack DM):
- Maple City Limo (airport transfers) — contact: Kamal Singh, +1-416-555-0199, invoice@maplecitylimo.ca — preferred vendor, corp rate on file.
- SkyLine AV (speaker AV) — contact: Priya Malhotra, +1-647-555-2234, priya@skylineav.ca — confirm HDMI passthrough and clicker.
- ExpoBuild Booths (booth crew) — contact: Thomas Ibarra, +1-416-555-7812, invoices@expobuild.ca — on-site lead: Thomas. Collect signed delivery ticket.
- Local catering (partner reception) — contact: Liza Catering, +1-416-555-6621, liza@lizacatering.ca — prepay deposit? ask partner to cover 50% invoice.

On-site ops notes:
- Badge pickup: Exhibitor badges at South Hall back desk; bring ID and company card.
- Booth setup window: 4/20 07:00–09:30. ExpoBuild crew to confirm 07:15 arrival.
- Partner reception: 4/21 19:00–21:00 — to be billed to partner code PART-2026 (need signed agreement).
- Speaker slot: 4/21 14:00–14:30 — AV check 30 min before, backup laptop at booth.

Expense coding cheat sheet (for quick entry):
- Flights: TRAVEL-FLIGHTS-INFRA
- Hotel: TRAVEL-HOTEL-INFRA
- Meals: TRAVEL-MEALS-INFRA (attach receipts)
- Ground: TRAVEL-GROUND-LCL
- Booth / Vendor invoices: CAPEX-EXPO-2026 (procurement review required)

Reimbursement timeline & tips:
- Submit expenses within 7 days of trip end. Flag urgent reimbursements as "expedite" in Concur if > $1,000 out-of-pocket.
- Add short notes on large items: "booth deposit split with Partner X — see email thread" with linked_artifact JIRA/Confluence id.
- Keep backups: take 2 photos of each receipt (one close-up, one contextual w/ vendor name).

Loose reminders / misc:
- Bring multi-country power adapter and HDMI->USB-C dongle.
- Put spare business cards in zipped pocket.
- If partner needs invoice copy on-site, ask ExpoBuild to provide it at setup (Thomas).
- If any vendor refuses corporate billing, escalate to procurement@redwood.ai with vendor name + sample invoice.

Post-trip actions (after return):
- [ ] Finalize and submit expense report (Maya).
- [ ] Share consolidated vendor invoices with Finance (Jordan).
- [ ] Upload all receipts to Confluence event page (Priya).
- [ ] Quick post-mortem notes: 1 pager on what went well / tickets for follow-ups.

Notes to self (messy):
- Keep receipts flat so photos are legible; use scanning app if glare.
- Record exchange rate used if converting CAD to USD manually.
- Double-check partner reception guest list 4/19.
- Speaker promo: ask Marketing for one-sheeter to leave at booth.

End of page. Throw everything here that the Finance reviewer might want — dates, vendor contact, invoice numbers, who paid what.

Last edited quick log: 
- 2026-03-05: added Maple City Limo contact + updated per-diem reminder.
- 2026-02-14: initial draft with travel dates and bookings.
